name: aesthetic-direction
title_zh: 先定一个视觉方向，再让字体配色间距版式动效全跟着它走
tagline_zh: 网页做完总像框架默认模板？它逼你先选一个方向，再让字体、配色、间距、版式、动效全从那个方向推导出来，成品不再撞脸。
tagline_en: Sites keep ending up looking like framework defaults? It forces one direction first, then derives type, color.
desc_en: Give a web interface a deliberate visual identity — choose one direction, then derive type, colour, spacing, layout, and motion from it so the result does not read as a framework default. Use when designing or restyling pages, landing sites, dashboards, or components in HTML/CSS/React; not for terminal UIs, print, or brand-guideline documents.
why_zh: 不是给一堆风格选项让你挑，而是先锁定一个方向，再逐层推导每个设计决策，机制上杜绝了混搭和默认感。
why_en: No style picker — it locks one direction first, then derives every decision from it, structurally preventing mashups and default.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML/CSS/React 的网页界面；终端 UI、印刷品、品牌规范文档不适用。产物是设计推导过程与决策说明。
limit_en: Web UI only (HTML/CSS/React); not for terminal, print, or brand guidelines. Output is design rationale, not final code.
title_en: Pick one visual direction, then derive every style choice.
